nom: Bliss Bright Idea Vitamin C Brightening Face Serum - 1 Fl Oz - Long-Lasting

segments.combination: The one reviewer who identifies as having oily/combination skin reports brighter, more nourished-looking skin and no noticeable difference compared to a much pricier serum she previously used.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several report no irritation and better results than other vitamin C products, while at least one with sensitive skin, eczema, or a compromised barrier reports a severe reaction of burning, swelling, and rash requiring medical treatment, and one reviewer without sensitive skin reports an equally severe reaction.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe themselves as mature or in their 50s and older report brighter, more vital-feeling skin and a softened look to wrinkles and pores with consistent use, though one 55-year-old reviewer with no prior history of reactions to any product reports a severe reaction of swelling, redness, and cracking around the eyes requiring emergency treatment that recurred when she reintroduced the product months later.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the serum for signs of aging report a softened look to wrinkles, pores, and skin tone with consistent use over several weeks, including a tightening effect on the skin, though one reviewer who bought it for sagging neck skin and fine lines around the eyes and lips says results are inconclusive after a few weeks of reduced-frequency use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as sufficiently hydrating on its own, layered over toner and under moisturizer, leaving skin feeling dewy, soft, and not dry.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report their skin turned red, swollen, and burning after use, in some cases severe enough to require emergency or dermatologist treatment with oral steroids, while other reviewers with sensitive skin report no stinging, burning, or redness at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with eczema and a history of perioral dermatitis attributes her severe reaction to the serum being too strong for sensitive or already-compromised skin barriers.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report a real reduction in dark spots and hyperpigmentation with consistent use over weeks to months, including one who documented visible fading in photos taken a year apart, though one reviewer cautions that brightening is gradual and the serum is not a quick fix for uneven skin tone.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers report their skin broke out in bumps or a painful rash after use, in one case progressively worsening over several applications, while at least one reviewer reports pre-existing bumps clearing up.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers, including one with oily/combination skin, report the serum absorbs without an oily or greasy feel, unlike some other vitamin C serums that are oil-based.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under moisturizer and makeup
Pump leaves significant product stranded at bottom
Packaging redesign seen as a downgrade
Some bottles have a defective pump lid

extraits.titre: Holy Allergic Reaction… Eczema Peeps Proceed With Caution
extraits.texte: YIKES…. Not sure where to start. So I have pretty sensitive skin, I do have eczema and I have had peri-oral dermatitis in the past but I HAVE used this brand of vitamin C serum before. I chose to go with a vitamin c and peptide brightener because I am a breastfeeding momma so I have to avoid retinols, retinoids, AHAs, BHAs, etc. BOY DO I WISH I WOULD HAVE SKIPPED THIS ONE. Upon application, my skin was seemingly adjusting ok. Hours went by, I started to feel a stinging sensation. I washed my face a moisturized with my normal products. That night, I had very red, tight, burning skin and I also felt maybe light swelling. The next day was the same of rough, red, burning skin and the swelling continued, almost as if I had chemical burns. 2 days after initial application, I woke up to have my eyes almost swollen shut. A fast trip to Urgent Care, a steroid shot and meds later, and I was finally recognizable again. Basically, if you have sensitive skin, eczema, etc I don’t think this is the product for you. I think the reformulation is just too strong for skin with sensitive/compromised barrier. As for the price, not bad for a chemical burn/exfoliant lol I had to go through a lot of pain but I basically have new skin 😂 no but really, proceed with caution on this one if you are super sensitive. Everyone is different but Patch test FOR SURE! I wish I had!!!

extraits.titre: Impressed With This Skin Soothing Serum
extraits.texte: It's early days yet of using this serum, but so far, I am impressed with how it makes my skin feel. I'm a "mature woman of a certain age", and it's been a revelation as to how this Bliss serum is giving me a sense of renewed vitality to my skin. Am hoping that this rejuvenation effect will continue to improve my skin over time. The serum lotion is lightweight, and a little bit goes a long way. I use it on my whole face, avoiding the eye area, and also on my neck. There is a bit of a residue feeling, but that also supports the skin tone improvement effect. I've certainly tried other options like Retinol. This Bliss serum feels better to me than others, so I'm going to keep using it and hope for even more positive results.

extraits.titre: Love this product. Love the price
extraits.texte: I’m 67. Have oily/combination skin. Love this product. The price is great. I went back to my $80.00/ bottle of serum and determined I couldn’t tell any difference between the two. So glad I did a comparison to know I was getting the best value! Cha Ching! And my skin looks brighter and feels “nourished”

extraits.titre: Gentle, Hydrating, and Non-Oily - Love It!
extraits.texte: I absolutely love this serum. It’s hydrating without leaving me oily, which is a huge plus since so many other vitamin C serums tend to be in an oil-based formula that doesn’t work well for my skin. Most importantly, it does not irritate my sensitive skin - something I often struggle with when using active ingredients like vitamin C. I have noticed some brightening, but it’s gradual. It took about 4 to 6 weeks of consistent use to start seeing the difference, so patience is key. Just keep in mind that this isn’t a magic fix if you struggle with uneven skin tone - it’s a great addition to your routine, but make sure you’re also wearing SPF daily to protect your skin and support the brightening effects. Definitely a keeper in my routine!
These pictures are 1 year apart. You can see that the dark spot has significantly faded with use several times a week. Over that time I used almost 1 bottle. Will definitely purchase again.

extraits.titre: Allergic Reaction - Do a spot test!!
extraits.texte: Please, PLEASE do a test spot with this stuff before you put it all over your face. I know plenty of people seem to not have a reaction, but as you can see, I had a bad time with this serum. I used it 2-3 times and within that time frame, my face broke out in these bumps that progressively got worse. I've stopped using it of course, but now my skin will probably take a while to heal. I've used different vitamin C products in the past and never had this happen, so I think it's something else that my skin doesn't like. Just be careful, and keep an eye on your skin if this is a new product for you.

extraits.titre: Love the scent and consistency. Jury’s still out on effectiveness.
extraits.texte: I bought this to use each night on my saggy neck skin and fine lines that are appearing around my eyes and lips. The first night, no problems, but the next night I developed an itchy rash on my neck. Now, I use it every 2-3 days. Pros: •very lightweight •consistency somewhere between a gel & a serum •lovely refreshing mandarin orange scent •cools the skin a bit immediately after application •dispenses with an easy-to-use pump •a little goes a long way •skin feels really supple about 30 minutes after application Cons: •may not be good for daily use if you have sensitive skin •no noticeable differences after a few weeks of use Not sure if I will re-order. That delicious citrus scent is absolutely lovely, though.
